Cherry PatientFi WELCOME TO OUR MEDICAL SPA IN PORTLAND, MAINE AN INCLUSIVE, INTIMATE SKINCARE AND WELLNESS CENTER IN THE HEART OF DOWNTOWN Portland, Maine Maine Aesthetic Medicine was founded by Brooke Harris, a local Maine Aesthetic Nurse practicing since 2015. Widely regarded as one of the most sought-after Aesthetic Nurses in Maine, Brooke has assembled a team of established healthcare professionals with over two decades of combined experience in advanced aesthetic treatments. OUR SERVICES Our selection of holistic, corrective and medical grade treatments are individually customized, reflecting the needs and goals of each patient. Spa Services Maine Aesthetic Medicine offers advanced technique facials designed to promote and stimulate the cellular health and wellness of the skin. Learn More Injectables Injectables are used to relax facial wrinkles and lift folds, contour the body and improve the signs of facial fat loss by creating structure, framework and volume to the face. Learn More Hormone Optimization Maine Aesthetic Medicine provides pharmacy-grade nutraceuticals and medically supervised hormone therapy to help patients throughout Maine support graceful aging and overall vitality. Learn More Weight Loss Management program Transform your wellness journey with our medically guided Weight Loss Management Program. Utilizing GLP-1 therapy alongside personalized... Learn More Dermatology Services Elevate your skincare with our expert dermatology services. From advanced medical treatments to preventive skin care, our board-certified professionals provide solutions for acne. Learn More Products Maine Aesthetic Medicine provides medical-grade products designed for all skin types. Each formula enhances treatment results, supports daily skin health. Learn More Concerns Discover how we treat your specific concerns with a blend of holistic care and medical-grade expertise creating personalized solutions that nurture your skin and confidence. Leaving my appointment, I learned more about my skin and left feeling so glowy and refreshed! Jessie is very professional and knowledgeable while also creating such a comfortable, calming, and enjoyable atmosphere. I left feeling beautiful and also with a couple more products customized to me! I will DEFINITELY be back to see Jessie! Highly recommend booking your next appointment with Maine Aesthetics Medicine! Kelly P. patient review The staff at Maine Aesthetic Medicine is incredible! From the moment you step in you feel welcomed and know you’re going to feel pampered! Brooke is knowledgeable, passionate and incredibly down to earth! She makes sure you’re comfortable with the service you’re going to have and wants to be sure you love it too! I highly recommend coming in and experiencing it for yourself! Rebecca patient review I started seeing Avery through her wellness program because I wasn’t feeling like myself, even though I had been following a treatment plan from my primary care doctor that was considered appropriate. From the beginning, the experience with Avery felt completely different-she really took her time with me, asked thoughtful questions, and genuinely cared about figuring out what was going on. Sydne C. patient review Absolutely beautiful. From the moment you walk in, the serene, welcoming atmosphere and soothing aromas set the perfect tone. The front desk staff is incredibly sweet and ensures the process is seamless. This isn’t my first time seeing Brooke for lip filler, and she continues to exceed my expectations every time. She has a remarkable ability to enhance both inner and outer beauty, always focusing on the person as a whole, not just the procedure. Her expertise, passion, and attention to detail are unmatched, and her calm, welcoming demeanor makes each visit a pleasure. I have complete confidence in Brooke and her team and can’t wait to go back! Ashley R. patient review Today I had my first facial ever at Maine Aesthetic Medicine and it was incredible! Jessie was so welcoming and talked me through the entire treatment process. The space is beautiful and right in downtown Portland. I felt so relaxed and pampered during my facial, and it turned out amazing! Already booked another one for both my sister and I! Could not recommend more:) Zoe patient review The space is so gorgeous! Avery was very knowledgeable and professional! SITUATED IN THE HEART OF DOWNTOWN Portland, Maine This talented team have amasses rapport in the industry and are caring providers with excellent skill level and extensive knowledge in their respective specialities. Offering a range of medical grade services and skincare products for all skin types, Maine Aesthetic Medicine was created with our patients in mind. Our goal is to provide a relaxing and open atmosphere for you to unwind, refresh, and reach your skincare goals. Our location offers these amenities: Rooftop Deck 1st hour of parking validated through Ocean Gateway Garage Within walking distance of Portland’s best restaurants & shops BOOK NOW We use & carry these products Available for purchase HELPING HANDS 1% of all proceeds is donated to HAND-Philippines Org, a non-profit medical mission group founded by our Medical Director, Reynerio “Lance” Lanoy MD. Owner, Brooke Harris BSN,RN serves as chair of this non-profit who provide access to free healthcare to calamity-stricken areas of rural Philippines. For volunteer inquiries (medical and non-medical volunteers needed) or to ask about our once a year auction and gala, email info@hand-philipines.org or find us on instagram @handphilippinesorg .
